intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryIngestController without changing its tabled contract or the frozen tests; keep it consistent with: Device ingestion endpoint of Telemetry Intake: POST /api/v1/telemetry/packets accepting ONE JSON object (IngressPacketDto) per request. Declared as a handler via class-level @Controller + @RequestMapping with @ResponseBody methods (the controller marker is REQUIRED: WebFlux maps only annotated classes - a marker-less bean is constructed but serves 404; component-scan registration is authoritative, the wiring factory same-name @Bean yields to it and must not duplicate the mapping). Nested public records: IngressPacketDto(String deviceId, List<SampleDto> samples), SampleDto(String metric, Instant tDevice, double value), IngressAck(int accepted). DTO validation is activated by @Valid on the parameter with @NotBlank deviceId, @NotEmpty samples, @NotBlank metric, and tDevice required. ingest reads requestId from the Reactor Context (Mono.deferContextual, fallback "unknown"), maps samples to TelemetrySample (status PENDING, placeholder tIngress Instant.EPOCH, correlationId = requestId), calls the IntakeService instance method receive and answers 202 with IngressAck(accepted). handleValidation is an @ExceptionHandler for WebExchangeBindException returning a 400 ProblemDetail (application/problem+json). DTO shapes stay in this interface layer; the application port speaks domain types only.
